required.asked_by: Name any Machine that is not Running
required.rationale: the one ocpv07 Machine whose phase is not Running. Its name carries its MachineSet's name as a prefix (the OpenShift <machineset>-<suffix> convention), so it also identifies the short set; no separate set-name fact, because a required 'cnv-metal-b' would make the decoy claim 'cnv-metal-b is fully ready' unforbiddable (hazard 12)

required.asked_by: give the phase it is stuck in
required.rationale: the Machine's own phase field. Case-insensitive so 'stuck in provisioning' counts; the word does not appear in the instruction

none_of: every machineset has the replicas it wants ready, and every machine is up.
forbidden.rationale: precision over recall (hazard 8). Only forms that cannot sit inside their own negation, an exception clause or a forward-looking remediation: an affirmative 'yes, both machinesets are/have'; the two set names declared ready together; the instruction's two questions answered as one affirmative sentence (ending at its full stop, so 'every Machine is up except ...' does not match); cnv-metal-b at 4 ready of 4 ('replicas 4, ready 4'; 'cnv-metal-b: 4/4', '4 desired, 4 ready' and 'desired 4, ready 4' were dropped because honest remediation targets use them); the decoy reading of cnv-metal-b with ocpv14's 2/2 numbers; and the stuck Machine listed, tabulated or enumerated as Running. No form may carry the full Machine name or the phase word (hazard 12), so enumerations ending '... and cnv-metal-b-x6dtm are all Running' and 'x6dtm was Provisioning briefly' cannot be forbidden Bare 'x6dtm is running' / 'x6dtm are (all) running' are absent: they sit inside 'once x6dtm is Running' and 'All Machines except cnv-metal-b-x6dtm are Running', and 'x6dtm is running, like every other machine' sits inside 'once x6dtm is Running, like every other Machine'. attributed_to 'ocpv14' excuses a sentence that describes the other cluster's set

extra_any_of: three ready replicas out of four
wants four replicas but only three
all but one of its four
all but one of the four
three replicas are ready out of the four
3 replicas are ready out of the 4
counts.asked_by: say how many of its replicas are ready out of how many desired
counts.rationale: cnv-metal-b on ocpv07: ready_replicas 3 of replicas 4, graded as the PAIR. The numeric rule is the ready value 3 (digit-guarded, so 13 or 1.3 do not count) within the window of a 4 or 'four' token (a noun match only at a token start that ends at a word boundary, so the proximity rule does not count 14 or 40; the extra_any_of forms are plain substrings and carry no such guard). A lone 3 or a lone 4 earns nothing under the proximity rule unless the other number happens to fall within the 10-token window, so an agent that quotes replicas: 4 off the row with no 3 nearby and declares everything ready banks nothing. extra_any_of keeps the pair notations whose numbers sit further apart. No other row on either cluster carries a 3 or a 4 (the healthy set and the decoy are both 2/2)
